tools.name: crypto-fear-greed
tools.description: [Intelligence] Get the Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0=Extreme Fear, 100=Extreme Greed). Real-time data, no API key required. Source: alternative.me. Returns current value, trend, 7-day history, contrarian signal, and market note.

tools.name: macro-fred-cpi
tools.description: Get CPI (Consumer Price Index) data from FRED. Returns MoM and YoY inflation rates.

months.description: Number of months of CPI data to return (default 12)

tools.name: macro-fred-nfp
tools.description: Get Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP) data from FRED. Returns monthly job change in thousands.

months.description: Number of months of NFP data to return (default 12)

tools.name: macro-fred-m2
tools.description: Get M2 Money Supply data from FRED with 52-week YoY growth rate.

weeks.description: Number of weeks of M2 data to return (default 53)

tools.name: macro-fred-yield-spread
tools.description: Get 10Y-2Y Treasury Yield Spread from FRED. Negative spread signals potential recession.

days.description: Number of trading days of data to return (default 90)

tools.name: macro-fred-unemployment
tools.description: Get US Unemployment Rate data from FRED.

tools.name: macro-fred-sahm
tools.description: Get Sahm Rule Real-Time Recession Indicator from FRED. Value ≥ 0.5 signals recession.

tools.name: macro-fred-fed-rate
tools.description: Get Federal Funds Effective Rate from FRED.

days.description: Number of trading days to return (default 90)

tools.name: macro-fred-all
tools.description: Get a combined macro snapshot from FRED: latest CPI, NFP, M2 YoY, yield spread, unemployment, Sahm Rule, and Fed Rate in one call. Returns cached data when available (source=prefetch) with fetchedAt and fredDate for transparency.

source.description: prefetch = served from scheduled cache; realtime = fetched live

fetchedAt.description: ISO timestamp: when the server fetched this data from FRED

tools.name: macro-fred-cache-clear
tools.description: Clear the in-process FRED data cache. Pass a series prefix to clear selectively, or omit to clear all.

prefix.description: Cache key prefix to clear (e.g. 'cpi', 'm2'). Omit to clear all.

tools.name: wallet-guard-token-security
tools.description: Detect ERC20 token contract risks: honeypot (貔貅), hidden minting, abnormal tax rate, blacklist/whitelist functions, malicious ownership, and 20+ other risk indicators. Use when user asks 'is this token/contract safe?'

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID string. Common values: "1" = Ethereum, "56" = BSC, "137" = Polygon, "8453" = Base, "43114" = Avalanche, "42161" = Arbitrum

contract_addresses.description: One or more token contract addresses, comma-separated (0x-prefixed)

tools.name: wallet-guard-address-security
tools.description: Check if a wallet or contract address is flagged as malicious: phishing activity, hacker, scam, darknet, terrorist financing, and 12+ risk categories. Use when user wants to know if an address is dangerous or a blacklisted scammer.

address.description: Wallet or contract address to check (0x-prefixed EVM address)

chain_id.description: Optional chain ID to narrow the check. EVM chain ID string. Common values: "1" = Ethereum, "56" = BSC, "137" = Polygon, "8453" = Base, "43114" = Avalanche, "42161" = Arbitrum

tools.name: wallet-guard-approval-security
tools.description: Scan a wallet address for dangerous token/NFT approvals: unlimited ERC20 approvals, suspicious spender contracts, ERC721/ERC1155 NFT approval risks. Use when user asks 'what are my dangerous approvals' or 'scan my wallet for risky permissions'. Covers ERC20, ERC721, and ERC1155.

type.description: Approval type to scan: erc20, erc721, erc1155, or all (default)

address.description: Wallet address to scan for approvals (0x-prefixed)

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID string. Common values: "1" = Ethereum, "56" = BSC, "137" = Polygon, "8453" = Base, "43114" = Avalanche, "42161" = Arbitrum

tools.name: wallet-guard-nft-security
tools.description: Detect NFT contract risks: transfer restrictions, trading paused, blacklist mechanisms, fake floor prices, and other ERC721/ERC1155 contract dangers. Use when user asks 'is this NFT collection safe?'

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID string. Common values: "1" = Ethereum, "56" = BSC, "137" = Polygon, "8453" = Base, "43114" = Avalanche, "42161" = Arbitrum

token_id.description: Optional specific token ID to check

tools.name: wallet-guard-phishing-site
tools.description: Check if a URL is a phishing or impersonation website targeting Web3 users. Use when user shares a link and asks 'is this website safe?' or 'is this a scam site?'

url.description: URL to check for phishing risk (e.g. https://uniswap-airdrop.com)

tools.name: wallet-guard-rugpull-detection
tools.description: [Beta] Detect rug-pull risk for a DeFi protocol contract. Analyzes liquidity lock, ownership, admin privileges, and other signals that indicate a potential exit scam. Use when user asks 'will this DeFi project rug pull?'

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID string. Common values: "1" = Ethereum, "56" = BSC, "137" = Polygon, "8453" = Base, "43114" = Avalanche, "42161" = Arbitrum
